## Текущий обзор

[reva-review](../../portfolio/2026-09-03--2026-09-15/review.md) — FULL_TEXT_REVIEWED. Author results not reproduced; transfer requires controlled attention signal and project source verification.

## Итоговое исследовательское решение

**ACCEPT_RESEARCH_ONLY** — ограниченный статус работы, не разрешение внедрения. History-indexed evidence views are only a research reference when attention traces from the exact generator are available.

Ограничения: Closed APIs generally do not expose necessary attention; offline score-store generation, index storage and model drift not measured.
